# Decision History

Development evidence only.

## Dated decisions

| Date | Study | Active questions | What changed | Decision | Next study |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-16 | **Candidate semantic profiles** (`semantic-profiles`) | `candidate-evidence` | Profile evidence improved development ranking in fusion, while weighting variants produced mixed outcomes. | `adopt`: Promote equal-weight dense/profile fusion; retain profile-only as a control. | — |
| 2026-07-21 | **Four-model reference-answer review** (`four-model-reference-review`) | `reference-reliability`, `response-evidence` | Gemini was the strongest reviewed default, with a material advantage on the purposive sample. | `adopt`: Use Gemini as the default reference generator while retaining Perplexity evidence and escalation. | — |
| 2026-07-21 | **Gemini grounding failure review** (`gemini-grounding-failure-review`) | `failure-conditions`, `reference-reliability` | Grounding materially helped many true failures but did not provide a reliable blanket cure. | `iterate`: Develop a two-pass disagreement trigger rather than grounding every request. | — |
| 2026-07-23 | **Grounded reference data-quality audit** (`grounded-data-quality-audit`) | `failure-conditions`, `reference-reliability` | The corpus is structurally complete, but uncertain and non-Search records require stratified source-level review. | `iterate`: Adjudicate uncertain records and a stratified non-Search sample before treating references as validated ground truth. | — |

## Current question snapshots

These rows are regenerated from canonical question records; they are current states, not additional dated decisions.

| Updated | Question | Status | Current bounded answer | Confidence boundary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-24 | **Can candidate-side semantic evidence improve query-only retrieval?** (`candidate-evidence`) | `partially_answered` | Yes on development evidence, subject to the evidence limits below. | Development-only evidence; candidate artifacts have mixed custody and the hidden test is unavailable. |
| 2026-07-24 | **When do promising signals fail?** (`failure-conditions`) | `open` | Failures cluster around ambiguity, entity resolution, evidence custody, scope changes, and over-tuned fusion, but no complete predictor exists. | Observed development and audit failures are diagnostic; they do not estimate hidden-test prevalence. |
| 2026-07-24 | **How far can query-only routing go?** (`query-only-routing`) | `partially_answered` | Dense query neighbors are a useful stable control, but candidate-side evidence improved development results. | Development-only evidence; repeated tuning on the same queries may overfit and the hidden test is unavailable. |
| 2026-07-24 | **How reliable must a generated reference be?** (`reference-reliability`) | `partially_answered` | Gemini was the strongest reviewed default, but difficult and ambiguous cases still need selective escalation. | The 400-question review was purposive and has no organizer gold; the grounding audit focused on known failures. |
| 2026-07-24 | **Can model responses provide useful ranking evidence?** (`response-evidence`) | `partially_answered` | Direct lexical response retrieval underperformed; bounded refinement and reference-based paths have separate evidence. | Most ranking evidence is development-only and some response corpora are private or locally held. |
